description: This file defines a static internal class containing constants and a collection for various database provider invariants related to ADO.NET in Orleans, covering different database types such as SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite. It also includes conditional namespace selection based on compilation symbols.

classes.name: AdoNetInvariants
classes.description: A holder for well known, vendor specific connector class invariant names used in Orleans ADO.NET storage implementations.

methods.name: Invariants
methods.description: A collection of supported database invariant names.
